   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  January 12, 2026

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:12 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang,
Commissioner Sanchez, Commissioner Garcia and Commissioner Lopez. Also present was Alex
Ocegueda, Office Assistant III and Jocelyn Hernandez, Communications Specialist.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Chair Leon made the motion and Commissioner Sanchez seconded to approve the minutes for
December 8, 2025. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Holiday Home Decoration Contest

Ms. Ocegueda collected the judging packets from Commissioners and will reach out to the winners
once the ratings were calculated. Commission discussed making changes to the contest to attract more
participation for next year. Commissioners asked staff to change submission and judging timeline to
announce winners before the holiday and give the contest a new name and logo.

Native Garden Contest

Ms. Ocegueda asked Commissioners to pull a ticket to determine the six (6) winners out of the 16
entries received for the raffle of the native plants provided by Cerritos College. Mrs. Ocegueda
reminded Commissioners their next scheduled promotional event will be in March at the annual Artastic
event.

   Public Comments: Resident Brian Tindell, expressed his thanks to the Commission for moving
  forward with promoting native plants and is looking forward to entering the contest

PastForward Series

Mrs. Ocegueda presented the approved logo to the Commissioners with three (3) full color options to
choose from. Commissioners asked staff for modifications to bring back at the next meeting for a final
decision.

Merchandise

Mrs. Ocegueda read an email received from the Norwalk Town Square management team that provided
more insight on the use of their sign for merchandise purposes. After discussion, Commission asked
staff to redesign the Keepin’ It Norwalk Logo to feature the city’s water tower. Commission and staff will
continue to research possible vendors.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
January 12, 2026

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Ms. Hernandez provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair recapped his experience spreading holiday cheer with his dune buggy. Commissioner
Sanchez recapped his weekend gathering with fellow retired military comrades in 29 Palms and
apologized for missing on attending the Las Posadas event. Chair Leon stated she was unable to attend
the Las Posadas event because she was out of town.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:33 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
